title.zh: 第 26 关组装问题修复

items.en: Level 26 now opens the Newtonian assembly bench after Level 25, including for existing saves that still remember the refractor bench.
items.zh: 完成第 25 关后，第 26 关会打开牛顿镜组装台；仍记着折射镜组装台的旧存档也会自动修正。

items.en: The starter refractor tube no longer appears equipped or equippable on the Newtonian bench; switching telescope families clears incompatible parts.
items.zh: 入门折射镜筒不再显示为牛顿镜已装备零件，也无法误装备；切换镜型会清理不兼容零件。

items.en: Regression checks cover old saves, the Level 25-to-26 transition, the assembly bench and the parts cabinet.
items.zh: 回归测试覆盖旧存档、第 25 关进入第 26 关、组装台与零件柜。

items.en: Level 10 records focused Saturn observations through the 32mm, 20mm and 10mm eyepieces even when a power is outside the final identification range; compare all three, then return to 20mm to identify Saturn.
items.zh: 第 10 关用 32mm、20mm、10mm 目镜对准土星并调焦后都会记录，即使倍率不满足最终识别条件；比较完三枚目镜后换回 20mm 识别土星。

items.en: Level 13's parts cabinet and automatic equipment follow the chosen target (Moon 10mm, Saturn 20mm, Pleiades 32mm); Level 16 picks the wide 32mm view for the Pleiades.
items.zh: 第 13 关零件柜与自动配装按实际选择的目标推荐（月球 10mm、土星 20mm、昴星团 32mm）；第 16 关观测昴星团改用视野更宽的 32mm。

items.en: Regression tests cover the full eyepiece sequence and the target-aware recommendations.
items.zh: 新增回归测试，覆盖完整目镜比较流程和按目标推荐。

items.en: A two-minute official trailer opens the landing page: a muted preview loops on screen, Watch Trailer glides to it and plays with sound, and the end screen offers Play, Watch Again or GitHub.
items.zh: 两分钟官方宣传片成为官网第一章：进入视野时静音预览循环，“观看预告片”滑到这里并带声播放，片尾可直接开始游玩、重看或前往 GitHub。

items.en: Pauses when scrolled away; phones and Save-Data connections get 720p, desktops 1080p, served from R2 with byte-range support.
items.zh: 滚走时暂停、回来继续；手机和省流量模式用 720p，电脑用 1080p，由 R2 按字节范围分发。

items.en: Open Graph / Twitter cards show the trailer poster and video when the link is shared.
items.zh: 分享链接时显示宣传片封面和视频卡片。

items.en: Rewrote the Chinese landing page from the opening through assembly, optics, observing and advanced instruments in shorter, more concrete observatory language.
items.zh: 重写中文官网，从开场、玛雅介绍到组装、光学、观测和高级仪器，去掉空泛宣传语，改成更短、更具体的天文台语言。

items.en: Corrected the dark-adaptation explanation (rod-cell sensitivity) and clarified focus, chromatic aberration, seeing and tracking terms.
items.zh: 更正暗适应说明（视杆细胞灵敏度），理清调焦、色差、视宁度、跟踪等术语。

title.zh: 云端战役存档可靠性更新

items.en: Registered observers starting a new campaign are no longer returned to an older cloud checkpoint (including the reported Level 43 case).
items.zh: 修复登录玩家开新战役后被带回旧云端进度的问题（包括反馈的第 43 关情况）。

items.en: New Game waits until account and cloud-save discovery completes, removing a startup race.
items.zh: “新游戏”会等账号和云存档检查完成后再开始，消除启动时的同步竞争。

items.en: A bilingual release bulletin opens once per version on the main screen and stays available in the account panel.
items.zh: 新增中英双语版本公告：每个版本在主界面弹出一次，之后可在账号面板查看。

items.en: Story dialogue now uses a lossless crop of the current eight-direction protagonist instead of the retired blocky headshot.
items.zh: 剧情对话头像改用当前八方向主角图集的无损裁切，不再使用旧的方块头像。

items.en: Six-frame animations in all eight directions replace the old four-direction, three-step walk.
items.zh: 主角换成八个方向、每个方向六帧的行走动画，替代旧的四方向三步动画。

items.en: Frames advance by distance travelled, so diagonals, low frame rates and blocked movement no longer skate or run in place.
items.zh: 按实际移动距离推进帧，斜走、低帧率和被挡住时不再“滑步”或原地跑。

title.en: Observatory Reliability, FAST Pulsar Rework and Community
title.zh: 可靠性、FAST 脉冲星重做与社区

items.en: FAST stage 4 is a continuous radio-analysis sequence: find the repeating clock, drag seven sub-bands into dispersion alignment, fold the phase and capture the pulse three times as it crosses the gate.
items.zh: FAST 第 4 阶段改为连续的射电分析：找重复时钟、拖动七条子频带对齐色散、旋转相位折叠，脉冲穿过闸门时按三次捕获。

items.en: The measured period, DM, pulse width and SNR flow into the report and saved archive, with a dedispersed-spectrum thumbnail in the journal.
items.zh: 测得的周期、色散量、脉宽、信噪比进入报告和存档，日志里生成消色散频谱缩略图。

items.en: Friend messaging opens the existing private conversation directly, with real-time drawers on the website.
items.zh: 游戏内好友消息直接打开已有私聊；官网加入实时私信抽屉。

items.en: Fixed account creation after a completed human check; the loading screen now clearly reads LOADING / 在加载中.
items.zh: 修复完成人机验证后注册失败；加载画面改为醒目的“LOADING / 在加载中”。

items.en: Continue appears only for resumable saves; the menu language carries into a new campaign; playtime uses foreground-only heartbeats so duplicate tabs cannot inflate it.
items.zh: 只有可继续的存档才显示“继续游戏”；主菜单选的语言会带进新战役；游玩时长只在前台计时，多开标签页不会重复累计。

items.en: Clicking outside Community or sign-in no longer closes it; use the close button or Escape.
items.zh: 点击社区或登录框外的暗处不再关闭它，改用关闭按钮或 Esc。

title.zh: 观测者账号与现场报告

items.en: Observer accounts with secure sessions and automatic cloud progress sync for the web build; an older cloud save cannot erase more advanced local progress.
items.zh: 上线观测者账号：安全会话，网页版进度自动云同步；旧的云存档不会覆盖更靠前的本机进度。

items.en: Categorized field reports from any page, each with a visible receipt, and a developer console to triage them.
items.zh: 任意页面都能提交分类反馈并拿到回执，开发者后台可以分拣处理。

items.en: Turnstile, a honeypot and rate limits protect sign-up and feedback; passwords use salted PBKDF2 hashes.
items.zh: 注册与反馈加入 Turnstile 人机验证、蜜罐和频率限制；密码使用加盐 PBKDF2 哈希。

items.en: Graduation is a four-part closing sequence: course recap, observing archive, equipment handover and the first independent night.
items.zh: 结业变成四段可玩的收尾：课程回顾、观测档案、光学器材交接、第一次独立观测之夜。

items.en: The observatory pad keeps your active optical telescope; visiting FAST or Space Infrared no longer overwrites it.
items.zh: 观测台记住你当前使用的光学望远镜，去过 FAST 或空间红外后不再被覆盖。

title.en: Official Website, /game/ Route and Advanced Observatory Pass
title.zh: 官网重做、/game/ 路由与高级观测台

items.en: New official website built around the game's own artwork, in chapters covering assembly, optics, observing modes, the instrument path and how each telescope works.
items.zh: 以游戏原画为核心重做官网，按章节讲组装、光学、观测模式、仪器路线和各类望远镜原理。

items.en: pixelobservatorygame.com serves the website and the game opens at /game/; GitHub Pages became a deployment mirror; large game files come from Cloudflare R2.
items.zh: pixelobservatorygame.com 显示官网，游戏在 /game/ 打开；GitHub Pages 改为部署镜像；大文件改由 Cloudflare R2 分发。

items.en: Tutorial-assistance levels, space-infrared slewing and wavefront alignment, a five-stage FAST flow and a first SFX layer.
items.zh: 新增教程辅助档位、空间红外姿态调整与波前对准、五阶段 FAST 流程和第一批音效。

items.en: Web exports disable desktop texture compression that greyed out menu and observatory imagery in browsers.
items.zh: 网页导出关闭桌面纹理压缩，修复浏览器里主菜单和观测台图片发灰。

title.en: Learning Diagram and Mobile Cabinet Update
title.zh: 学习图解与移动端零件柜

items.en: A larger light-gathering diagram (pupil, aperture, collected light, faint objects) and a bigger Concept Brief image area.
items.zh: 集光能力图解放大（瞳孔、口径、收集的光、暗弱天体），概念卡图片区域加大。

items.en: Touch swipe scrolling in the Parts Cabinet, with tap-versus-drag separation.
items.zh: 零件柜支持触屏滑动，并区分点按与拖动，避免误装零件。

title.zh: 观测地点、地平线与自由观测

items.en: Choose another observing site when a target is below the horizon, with world-map transitions and layered horizon scenery.
items.zh: 目标在地平线以下时可换观测地点，加入世界地图过渡和分层地平线景观。

items.en: Free observation of non-mission objects with a detailed panel; the source of each coordinate (online/local/offline) is shown.
items.zh: 自由观测非任务天体并查看详细面板；显示每个坐标的数据来源（在线 / 本地 / 离线）。

items.en: Godot web export through GitHub Actions and GitHub Pages (then at tntsg1.github.io/Pixel-Observatory/), later on the custom domain pixelobservatorygame.com.
items.zh: 通过 GitHub Actions 与 GitHub Pages 发布网页版（当时地址 tntsg1.github.io/Pixel-Observatory/），之后切到自定义域名 pixelobservatorygame.com。

items.en: Mobile Controller Mode: virtual joystick, interaction and mission buttons, scope switching, focus and collimation controls.
items.zh: 移动控制模式：虚拟摇杆、交互与任务按钮、镜筒切换、调焦与准直控制。

title.en: Advanced Telescope Framework and Observation HUD
title.zh: 高级望远镜框架与观测 HUD

items.en: Newtonian assembly and collimation, chromatic-aberration comparison, installed-part textures and interaction feedback.
items.zh: 牛顿式组装与准直、色差对比、已安装零件贴图和交互反馈。

items.en: Focus, seeing, clouds, drift, tracking and target-lock feedback; azimuth/altitude scales in DMS; reduced-motion support.
items.zh: 调焦、视宁度、云层、漂移、跟踪和目标锁定反馈；方位 / 高度刻度（度分秒）；减少动态效果选项。

title.zh: 观测 HUD 与目标反馈

items.en: New reticles for naked eye, finder and telescope; unified approach ring, lock ring and completion radius.
items.zh: 肉眼、寻星镜、望远镜三种准星更新；接近圈、锁定圈与完成半径统一。

items.en: Reflector data, nested tube blueprints and slots for primary mirror, cell, spider, secondary, focuser, eyepiece and collimation tool.
items.zh: 反射镜数据、嵌套镜筒蓝图，以及主镜、镜室、十字架、副镜、调焦座、目镜、准直工具槽位。

title.en: L10–L24 Teaching Structure and Observation Effects
title.zh: L10–L24 教学结构与观测效果规范

items.en: A spiral practice structure revisits concepts under different conditions; the effects of focus, seeing, clouds, brightness, drift, magnification and tracking were specified.
items.zh: 螺旋式练习结构让同一概念在不同条件下反复出现；定义调焦、视宁度、云层、亮度、漂移、倍率和跟踪对画面的影响。

milestones.zh: 木星观测贴图：清晰 / 模糊 / 暗淡三种状态

milestones.en: Unified Eye / Finder / Scope mode buttons
milestones.zh: 肉眼 / 寻星镜 / 望远镜模式按钮统一
星光天文台正式主菜单

milestones.en: Orion Nebula focus and quality pass
milestones.zh: 猎户座大星云通关体验修正

milestones.en: Focus knob as a real part
milestones.zh: 调焦旋钮成为真实零件

milestones.en: Parts Cabinet and Assembly Table separated

milestones.zh: 望远镜视野与观测质量
项目替换与 MVP 基础

gaps.en: Some advanced telescope families still need final artwork and family-specific interaction.
gaps.zh: 部分高级望远镜还缺最终美术和专属交互。

gaps.en: Later campaign content needs a diversity pass so targets and concept cards repeat less.
gaps.zh: 后期关卡需要丰富目标，减少重复的天体和概念卡。

gaps.en: Below-horizon travel needs a stronger transition and clearer world-map controls.
gaps.zh: 地平线以下换地点的过渡动画和世界地图操作还要加强。

gaps.en: Mobile controls need real Android testing and a final APK release process.
gaps.zh: 移动端操作需要真机测试和正式 APK 发布流程。
